reviews_extra_thumbtack.author: Brenda G.
reviews_extra_thumbtack.body: Giselle was awesome! We had a party of 6 women getting massages while our husbands were golfing. She coordinated everything and had two other masseuse with her. All of the massages were great. She was also very flexible and provided last minute massages to 3 of our husbands. The ladies were experienced, friendly, and very professional. We would definitely recommend Giselle's services!!
